commentary: Market breadth registers at a cautious 49 with the technical gate set to CAUTION, demanding strict Livermore patience and O'Neil market-direction discipline. Rather than broad-based advance, capital is rotating selectively into domestic industrial capex, specialized manufacturing, and clean power infrastructure. In Weinstein Stage 2 terms, benchmark indices are holding above long-term technical floors, but underlying divergences require progressive exposure and zero tolerance on stops. Legendary trading discipline dictates avoiding non-equity instruments, discarding fundamentally decaying laggards, and reserving fresh capital strictly for verified Stage 2 leaders breaking out on heavy institutional accumulation and accelerating earnings.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price holds above its EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot with positive MACD. However, volume expansion of 1.21× is lackluster, and lack of overhead clearance limits relative-strength momentum.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating performance deteriorated sharply in Q1 FY27, with sales plunging 56.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.6% YoY. Depressed ROCE of 5.6%, poor 3-year ROE of 3.1%, and declining promoter holdings fail CANSLIM investment standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails if price breaks below the 94.11 stop; exit promptly if support below the 50-day average gives way.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Forming a constructive double-bottom base above a rising 50-day and 200-day moving average. Volume expanded to 1.77× 20-day average on the neckline test, while an RSI of 52 reflects steady accumulation without technical extension.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Consolidated PAT accelerated 40.1% YoY to ₹1,174.7 Cr in Q1 FY27 on 27.9% revenue growth, powered by 28% NBFC and 50% housing finance AUM expansion. High leverage is normal for financial operations, alongside 10.8% ROE.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Fails on a close below 410.13; honor the stop if neckline resistance induces a sharp double-bottom reversal.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: An overnight money-market cash ETF lacking authentic Stage 2 equity price discovery, VCP compression, base structure, or relative-strength leadership.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Ineligible for growth capital allocation; risk discipline mandates immediate omission from equity momentum strategies.

ACE.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session pivot to fresh 52-week highs on 2.87× volume. Moving averages are stacked in bullish alignment (price > EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200), confirming potent Stage 2 institutional sponsorship.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant mobile crane manufacturer with 63% domestic market share. Q1 FY27 net profit accelerated 22.3% YoY to ₹119.5 Cr on 20.5% sales expansion. Superb capital efficiency marked by 31.6% ROCE, 22.8% ROE, and virtually debt-free balance sheet.
ACE.risk: Setup aborts if price breaks below 1123.57; cut losses immediately if the breakout pivot fails to hold.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Powerful SEPA breakout printing new trailing-year highs on explosive 4.89× 20-day average volume. Price is stacked cleanly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, demonstrating standout relative strength and accumulation.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Stellar Q1 FY27 execution with sales rising 67.8% YoY to ₹858 Cr and EPS surging 71.8% YoY to ₹3.71, driven by rapid battery energy storage capacity commissioning. High debt is typical of utilities, balanced by robust cash generation.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Pattern failure occurs on a breakdown below 394.55; enforce the stop without hesitation if breakout volume reverses.

ACUTAAS.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Volume running at 1.81× and RSI at 58 indicate healthy pre-breakout contraction characteristics.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Robust specialty pharma and CDMO ramp generated 59.1% YoY revenue growth to ₹330 Cr in Q1 FY27. OPM remains strong at 34.3% and ROE stands at 22.6% with negligible leverage. However, EPS YoY growth decelerated from Q4's 106% pace.
ACUTAAS.risk: Thesis invalidates below 3495.75; exit decisively if pivot base support fails, keeping drawdowns minimal.
